items.title: Introduce transition-orchestrator.ts coordinating one transition
items.context: Create packages/main/src/core/transition-orchestrator.ts that organizes a single transition: read the current story, determine the event, run the gate runner (phase-gates), apply state mutation, run transition effects (transition-effects / done-effects), and return a success/failure structure. It consumes the modules extracted in Story 3a and 3b plus the existing machine / registry / done-oracle. First version migrates the coordination logic only — gate decisions and transition results stay byte-identical.

items.title: Reduce story_advance.ts to a thin handler delegating to the orchestrator
items.context: story_advance.ts becomes a thin handler: parse CLI args, call transition-orchestrator, shape the response. It must no longer contain inline transition coordination, gate-runner bodies, or merge implementation. A thin handler means real delegation, not just moved comments. story-advance.ts line count drops substantially again.

items.title: Regression-prove zero CLI/semantics change and no circular imports
items.context: Extend smoke/contract coverage to prove: external CLI behavior (story_advance for every transition), TEST semantics, legacy phase handling, and workflow profile are all unchanged; the new modules have clear single responsibilities with no circular imports; StoryPhase / legacy phase types are untouched. Run build + flow-stability + validation-protocol + lifecycle-registry-contract + process-fact-contract + runtime-fact-contract + worktree-authority-smoke.
